Ch1: Market Invite & Liquidity Grab. Trading rule.
Is chapter ka pehla paath. Market ko jab kisi bhi direction me achha khasa jaana hota hai, to wo pehle sabko invite karta hai. Bina invite kiye fast move nahi aata.
Dekho, market gap up khula. Gap up ke baad har koi gap filling ke liye sell side trade leta hai. Aur market ko upar jaane ke liye pullback bhi lena padta hai.
Price neeche aaya aur ek support bana. Retail traders is support par buy karte hain, aur apna stop-loss uske thik neeche lagate hain.
Support teen baar test hua. Jitni baar test hoga, utne zyada logon ke stop-loss support ke neeche jama honge. Yahi liquidity hai.
Ab market ne support ko tod diya, ek tez flick ke saath. Retail sellers ko laga ki breakdown ho gaya, aur wo sell side me aa gaye.
Dhyan do. Liquidity grab me retailers ki entry hoti hai, aur stop-loss hunt me unki exit. Dono ek hi khel ke do hisse hain.
Neeche aate hi price turant wapas upar aaya. Sellers ab trap ho chuke hain. Unka stop-loss upar rakha hai.
Market ne bahut saare retail sellers ko sell side bhej diya. Yaani ab upar jaane ke liye uske paas achhi khasi liquidity hai.
Note kar lo. Pehle sellers ko invite karna, phir unhe trap karna. Uske baad hi fast momentum aata hai.
Yaad rakho. Liquidity grab me retailers ki entry, stop-loss hunt me exit. Sellers trap hone ke baad buy side jaana aasan hota hai.
Ch2: Resistance Par Weakness. Bullish setup.
Ab dusra paath. Ye resistance zone dekho. Yahan price baar baar aaya aur har baar sellers ko invite kiya.
Pichli baar isi zone se price ne bahut strength ke saath neeche move kiya tha. Yaani us waqt yahan sellers taakatwar the.
Neeche aakar support bana, aur retailers ne wahan buy kiya.
Phir support ke neeche flick karke stop-loss uda diye. Sellers triggered ho gaye. Liquidity grab ho gayi.
Ab price wapas wahi resistance zone par aa raha hai. Retailers sochenge ki pehle bhi yahin se gira tha, to ab bhi sell karte hain.
Lekin ab dhyan se dekho. Is baar candles bahut weak hain. Koi strong red candle nahi aa rahi. Ye weakness hai. Sellers is baar kamzor hain.
Agar sellers zone par itne strong hote, to price ko neeche dhakel dete. Lekin wo ruk kar sellers ki liquidity jama kar raha hai.
Retailers sell karte rahenge, aur unke stop-loss zone ke upar jama honge. Market unhe hit karne upar jaa sakta hai. Teesri chauthi baar zone par aane par real breakout ho sakta hai.
Yaad rakho. Wahi resistance, lekin weak behaviour. Sellers pehle trap ho chuke hain, aur upar bahut stop-loss jama hain.
Ch3: Entry Plan, Pullback + Doji. Bullish setup.
Teesra paath. Entry kab aur kaise. Sabse pehle ek warning. Aam taur par breakout fail ho jaata hai, isliye breakout ke baad chase karke trade mat lo.
Price resistance par aakar baar baar weak candles bana raha hai. Ab hum bas intezaar karte hain.
Resistance zone par candles consolidate hongi, phir price neeche pullback dega. Yahi sabse best jagah hoti hai entry ki.
Pullback isliye zaroori hai, kyunki retailers ko sell side jaane ka confirmation mil jaata hai. Wo sochte hain ki ab to neeche hi jayega.
Ab chhote timeframe par dekho. Price ne neeche ka breakout kiya, aur ek doji candle bani. Pullback par doji, yahi entry ke liye best jagah hai.
Entry doji ke baad. Stop-loss doji ke low ke neeche, kyunki wahan tootne par poora idea galat ho jaata hai.
Dekho, ab fast move aaya. Market ko agar kisi ek direction me jaana hai, to wo jaldi chalu karega. Zyada time paas nahi karega. Bade move tabhi aate hain jab sabko invite kar liya ho.
Psychology. Ek baar trade le liya, to zyada sochna nahi hai. Apne stop-loss aur plan par bharosa rakho.
Yaad rakho. Breakout par nahi, pullback aur doji par entry. Aur ek baar entry li, to plan follow karo.
Ch4: Real Chart, Nifty 5 Min. Bullish setup.
Ab ek real Nifty ka paanch minute chart dekhte hain. Market gap up khula aur turant top zone se neeche aaya. Gap up ke baad sab gap filling ke liye sell karte hain.
Beech wale zone par price baar baar aaya aur sellers ko invite karta raha. Phir top zone par ek aur baar rejection aaya.
Price neeche aaya, aur ek strong green candle se wapas zone me aa gaya. Market dono taraf ke logon ko phasa raha hai.
Phir ek lamba consolidation. Retailers is beech me kabhi buy karte rahe, kabhi sell.
Ab ek strong red candle aayi aur price neeche wale zone ki taraf gaya. Yahan sellers strong dikh rahe hain.
Dhyan se dekho. Price ne neeche ke major zone ko tod diya aur flick ke saath sabse neeche tak gaya. Retail sellers ne ise breakdown samjha, aur unki liquidity grab ho gayi.
Turant ek strong green candle aayi. Price zone ke andar wapas aa gaya. Sellers trap ho gaye.
Ab price tezi se upar aaya, bina kisi bade pullback ke. Market ne sellers ko trap kar liya, aur ab uske paas upar jaane ki liquidity hai.
Teesri baar upar ke zone par aaya hai. Lekin is baar candles weak hain. Pehle yahin se neeche gaya tha, is baar strength nahi hai. Yaani sellers ab kamzor hain.
Ab pullback aaya hai aur doji ke saath ruk raha hai. Yahi entry ke liye best jagah hai. Stop-loss doji ke low ke neeche.
Yaad rakho. Market pehle sellers ko invite karta hai, phir liquidity grab, phir resistance par weakness, aur aakhir me pullback par doji. Yahi poora chapter hai.
